data.long_meaning: One who brings light and illumination in the shade or darkness. The name Goharshad carries the meaning “Light of the Shade” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian. Parents who choose Goharshad usually hope their child will grow to embody light of the shade and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.name: Goharshad
in_english.long_meaning: Gohar means 'radiant, bright, shining' in Persian. Shad means 'one'. So, Goharshad means 'Radiant, Bright, Shining One'.

data.cultural_impact: The name Goharshad holds a rich historical and cultural significance in Islamic history. It is believed that the name was given to revered scholars, saints, and rulers in the Islamic Golden Age. For instance, Goharshad Bibi, a renowned Sufi Saint and scholar during the Mughal era, is one of the most notable women in Islamic history to have carried this name. It also appears in Persian poetry, particularly in the works of the celebrated poet Rumi, where it represents the concept of spiritual illumination and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic philosophy, the name Goharshad holds profound spiritual significance. It symbolizes the essence of spiritual guidance and illumination that one experiences on their journey towards self-realization. Through the name, one acknowledges that even in the realm of spiritual darkness, there lies a guiding light – a reminder that is especially poignant during adversity and hardship. The name celebrates the idea that wisdom and knowledge can serve as a beacon of hope and understanding, helping individuals find their way towards spiritual growth and enlightenment.
